ModMetaData.name: Ideology Delete UI 1.5 v1.1
ModMetaData.author: Allen
ModMetaData.description:
Adds a delete button to every ideoligion row in the in-game Ideology screen and a developer action: Ideoligion -> Delete ideoligion....
v1.1: minor faction references no longer block deletion. They are detached automatically. Primary faction ownership and current pawn believers remain hard blockers. Deletion then uses RimWorld's own IdeoManager.Remove() and cleans baby ideology exposure references.
